description: The four governed external data intake vectors (data-ingestion-protocol). Each vector is declared with its permitted source types, whether it requires a host-level gate (SUDO or operator action), and whether agents may write to its landing floor. Vault-mounted and manually-vaulted data are read-only for agents; active work always lands in active/ floors.

manual_vaulting.description: Vector 1: a human copies files into knowledge/vault/ (or routes them through pnpm knowledge:ingest). Agent-visible landing is read-only vault content.

connector_skills.description: Vector 2: connector skills pull SaaS sources through the ingest-source-walker seam (box, slack, confluence, google_drive) and land through the ingest ceremony.

agentic_web_fetch.description: Vector 3: agent-driven fetches (api-fetcher, web_fetch, browser actuator). Results land under staging and are promoted through the ingest ceremony.

vault_mount.description: Vector 4: an operator mounts an external filesystem path under vault/mounts/ via a symlink created by the vault_mount_cli gate. Mounts are a filesystem security boundary, not a provider seam.
